run_gtest_list_tests: run the googletest-list-tests-unittest executable with gtest_list_tests flag to list all tests
test_gtest_list_tests_default_behavior: test the default behavior of gtest_list_tests when the flag is not set
test_gtest_list_tests_flag: test the gtest_list_tests flag with values 0 and 1 to verify output
test_gtest_list_tests_override_non_filte: test that gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like gtest_break_on_failure
test_gtest_list_tests_with_filter_flags: test that gtest_list_tests respects the gtest_filter flag for filtering test output
